description: This Java class defines a configuration object for MongoDB connection pools, specifically the 'DefaultConnectionPoolConfig' which implements settings such as max size, wait queue size, wait time, and JMX listener enablement based on external configuration.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionPoolConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing connection pool configuration for MongoDB, including max size, wait queue size, wait time, and JMX listener enablement.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultConnectionPoolConfig using a provided Config object, with error handling for invalid configurations.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of connections in the pool.

methods.name: getMaxWaitQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the wait queue for connection requests.

methods.name: getMaxWaitTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum duration to wait for a connection from the pool.

methods.name: isJmxListenerEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether JMX listener is enabled for the connection pool.
